name: Icy Blue Mechanostrider Replacement
summary: This errand involves exchanging an older model of the Icy Blue Mechanostrider with Milli Featherwhistle outside Ironforge. As gnomish vehicular engineering evolves, technicians offer direct trade-ins to ensure mounts remain standardized and properly tuned.

sections.title: Gnomish Vehicular Turnover
sections.body: Gnome ingenuity is rarely content to leave a finished design alone. Outside the gates of Ironforge at Steelgrill's Depot, mechanostrider handler Milli Featherwhistle oversees the ongoing distribution and maintenance of mechanized mounts. When newer revisions roll out of the workshop, pilots are encouraged to exchange earlier production frames to keep their machinery operating up to current standards.

sections.title: Care of the Mechanostrider
sections.body: Unlike flesh-and-blood mounts reared on ranches, mechanostriders demand rigorous mechanical upkeep, calibration, and grease. Upgrading or swapping an unarmored strider model at the depot allows gnomish technicians to inspect structural wear on the chassis and redistribute improved gyroscopes and leg servos across the Alliance.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trade-in?
faq.answer: Milli Featherwhistle offers this exchange to trade an older production model of the Icy Blue Mechanostrider for an updated chassis version, keeping gnomish engineering consistent across the Alliance.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: The exchange takes place at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, located just down the road east of Kharanos, where the gnomes tend to their mechanized mounts.
Milli Featherwhistle is the primary mechanostrider vendor and technician stationed in Dun Morogh, responsible for distributing mechanical mounts to eligible Alliance riders.

faq.q: Can any Alliance member ride a mechanostrider?
faq.answer: Gnomes ride them naturally, and dwarves who have earned high renown with Gnomeregan Exiles can learn to pilot them. Larger races, such as night elves, find the delicate frame ill-suited to their weight and stature.

faq.q: Why are gnomes selling mounts in Dun Morogh instead of Gnomeregan?
aliases: why are gnomes in dun morogh
faq.answer: Following the fall and contamination of Gnomeregan, the surviving gnomes established refugee operations and workshops in neighboring dwarven lands, including Tinker Town in Ironforge and Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Do mechanostriders require feeding like biological mounts?
faq.answer: No. Mechanostriders run entirely on clockwork engineering, internal combustion, and gnomish mechanical drive systems rather than food or water, though they require routine oiling and structural repair.

angles.text: The mechanostrider represents pinnacle gnomish ingenuity in transport, maintaining high mobility even after the tragic loss of Gnomeregan.
Every mechanostrider frame is a testament to fine gyroscopic balance, pistons, and gear ratios that inspire Alliance tinkers.
Steelgrill's Depot supplies the Alliance with nimble, mechanical cavalry mounts suitable for scout missions and rapid deployment across rugged snowfields.
